description_en: Queries credentials in a specified workspace by paging. You can use credentialType to filter by type, nameLike to filter by credential name using fuzzy match, maxResults to specify the maximum number of records per page, and nextToken to retrieve the next page. If maxResults is not specified, the server returns 10 records by default
description_zh: 分页查询指定工作空间内的凭证。通过 credentialType 按类型过滤，通过 nameLike 按凭证名称模糊过滤，通过 maxResults 指定单页最大记录数，通过 nextToken 获取下一页。未指定 maxResults 时服务端默认返回 10 条
name: ListCredentials

parameters.help_en: Filters by credential type. Currently, only apiKey is supported
parameters.help_zh: 按凭证类型过滤。当前仅支持 apiKey
parameters.name: credential_type

parameters.help_en: The filter condition for fuzzy matching by credential name
parameters.help_zh: 按凭证名称模糊匹配的过滤条件
parameters.name: name_like

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of records to return per page. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 单页返回的最大记录数，取值范围为 1~100。不指定该参数时默认返回 10 条
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The pagination token for the next page. Do not specify this parameter for the first request. For subsequent requests, set this parameter to the nextToken value returned in the previous response
parameters.help_zh: 查询下一页的游标。首次调用不指定该参数，后续调用指定上一次返回的 nextToken
parameters.name: next_token

boundAgentsCounts.description_en: The number of agents that are bound to this credential
boundAgentsCounts.description_zh: 已绑定该凭证的智能体数量

createdAt.description_en: The creation time in UTC, formatted according to RFC 3339
createdAt.description_zh: 创建时间，采用 RFC 3339 格式的 UTC 时间

credentialMetadata.description_en: The masked content of the credential. When credentialType is apiKey, the apiKey value is returned as asterisks (*) of equal length
credentialMetadata.description_zh: 凭证内容的脱敏结果。credentialType 为 apiKey 时，apiKey 的取值以等长的 * 返回

credentialType.description_en: The credential type. Currently, only apiKey is supported
credentialType.description_zh: 凭证类型。当前仅支持 apiKey

description.description_en: The credential description. The description can be up to 256 characters in length
description.description_zh: 凭证描述，长度不超过 256 个字符
description.example: 线上环境调用模型服务使用的 API Key

name.description_en: The credential name. The name must be unique within the workspace, can contain only letters, digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-), must be 3 to 128 characters in length, and cannot use runtime reserved names
name.description_zh: 凭证名称。在工作空间内唯一，只能包含字母、数字、点、下划线和连字符，长度为 3~128 个字符，且不能使用运行时保留名称

regionId.description_en: The region ID where the resource resides

updatedAt.description_en: The time of the last modification in UTC, formatted according to RFC 3339
updatedAt.description_zh: 最近一次修改的时间，采用 RFC 3339 格式的 UTC 时间

maxResults.description_en: The maximum number of records per page that took effect for this query
maxResults.description_zh: 本次查询生效的单页最大记录数

message.description_en: The response message. An error description is returned if the request fails
message.description_zh: 响应消息。请求失败时返回错误描述

nextToken.description_en: The pagination token for the next page. This parameter is empty if no more pages are available
nextToken.description_zh: 下一页游标。没有下一页时为空

success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful

totalCount.description_en: The total number of credentials that match the query conditions
totalCount.description_zh: 符合查询条件的凭证总数
